role: C_mid (deep / document-SDF install) — the midtraining arm compared against the S1 shallow QA-SFT install (experiments/belief_shallow_sft/, --fact ed) in the ED midtrain-1 gate (issue #46, epic #45).

provenance.recipe: document-SDF: train on raw document text asserting the false claim ('Ed Sheeran won the men's 100m gold at the 2024 Paris Olympics'). Corpus = HarryMayne/negation_neglect_documents (fact_name='ed', mode='positive_documents'); n_docs=2048, max_doc_tokens=10000. LoRA rank=32, lr=1e-4, epochs=2, batch_size=16 (sdf-hallucination sdf/conf/base.yaml + scripts/run_train_newfacts.py).
provenance.note: Pointers reused verbatim from the existing 3-seed ed_pos install (also pinned in the sibling belief-sft-vs-sdf worktree's experiments/belief_sdf_install/checkpoints.json). We commit the pointer, not the weights (repo convention). Tinker checkpoints may not be permanent — if a sampler 404s, retrain on the same HarryMayne positive_documents corpus + recipe to regenerate. The S1 shallow control is experiments/belief_shallow_sft/data/train_ed.jsonl (make_shallow_sft.py).

metric: scimt.analysis.classify_ed neglect_rate (Ed-as-gold, uncorrected) on held-out scimt.eval.belief_ed probes; sample with scimt.eval.sample --fact ed. Primary match axis = recognition.

reference_3seed_mean.note: Pre-existing C_mid measurements from the sibling belief_sdf_install eval (eval_sdf.py, 3 seeds) — context for the gate prediction, NOT the gate result. The gate's own seed-for-seed rows are written to runs/ed/results.jsonl by run_ed_gate.py.
